page.home.hero.quote: "Empowering creativity, connecting brands with authentic voices."
page.home.hero.title: Your Creative Marketplace for UGC Content in Morocco
page.home.hero.description: We're the bridge between brands and creators. Discover talented UGC creators, showcase your brand, and collaborate with the best content makers to bring your vision to life. Our platform secures your collaborations, ensuring creators get paid and brands get the content they need.
page.home.guide.step1.title: Step 1: Find Your Perfect Creator
page.home.guide.step1.description: Browse through profiles of talented UGC creators using advanced filters to find the perfect match for your brand and product. Filter by gender, ethnic background, age, language, pricing, and more to quickly locate the ideal persona for your campaign.
page.home.guide.step2.title: Step 2: Chat and Negotiate
page.home.guide.step2.description: Once you’ve found your match, reach out to the creator directly via our website chat. Present your product or project, discuss the terms, and negotiate the details of the collaboration in a streamlined and secure environment.
page.home.guide.step3.title: Step 3: Select, Pay, and Collaborate
page.home.guide.step3.description: Choose the best offer from the creator’s portfolio and make your payment securely through our platform. We’ll guide you step-by-step through the process, ensuring everything runs smoothly, from collaboration to delivery of the content.
page.home.whychoose.securepayments.title: Secure Payments
page.home.whychoose.securepayments.descr: We hold payments until the brand confirms the content meets the agreed terms, ensuring both parties are protected.
page.home.whychoose.paymentguarantee.des: Brands have 2 days to validate the delivery. If not, the payment goes to the creator automatically, avoiding disputes.
page.home.whychoose.hasslefree.title: Hassle-Free Process
page.home.whychoose.hasslefree.descripti: From finding creators to finalizing payments, everything is managed on one platform for a smooth, secure collaboration.
page.home.whyougc.title: Why Choose UGC for Your Brand?
page.home.whyougc.authenticity.title: Authenticity Builds Trust
page.home.whyougc.authenticity.descripti: 84% of consumers trust real people’s recommendations over ads. UGC helps you connect with your audience authentically.
page.home.whyougc.engagement.title: Boosts Engagement
page.home.whyougc.engagement.description: UGC drives 7x more engagement than brand content, sparking conversations on platforms like Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
page.home.whyougc.impactful.title: More Impactful
page.home.whyougc.impactful.description: UGC is 6x more trusted than ads, leading to stronger purchase decisions through relatable content.
